title: Second meeting: implants, not ganglion

tellings.quote: We did. And he he they said implants >> and it was it was more technological uh some kind of implants.

plain: In 1996, people who came to the Los Angeles offices of Dark Skies, a TV series, are said to have changed their story at a second meeting: what had earlier been a ganglion, a cluster of nerve cells, was now "some kind of implants", something more technological. Bryce Zabel, who worked on the show and was in the room, tells Michels this was said by a man he calls JC and another he calls the captain. If true, insiders were steering what a TV show said about aliens.
